summary: rcf-lite 0.41.0, the stripped twelve-rule process (Baz decision 14): the npm package stops shipping its own rcf/ (privacy), test strength becomes a recorded report that refuses nothing (integrity: Finalise and the TEST verdict refuse on structure only, a failing record no longer closes the round), and the managed agent-instructions block, rcf guidance build-cycle, the bundle runbook and rcf guidance overview state the twelve rules (product claim, core journey through rcf init and rcf doctor --fix).
approach: Builder orientation (the test-author's reading of the code at 892bc858e169, not a build): package.json:29 drops "rcf" from files. src/finalise/light.js:136-148 judgeTestStrength keeps the no-record and omits refusals and replaces the fails refusal with one stdout line per non-pass touched criterion ("test-strength at <H7>: <AC id> <fail|blocked>: <reason>; recorded, not refused"; the omits check must no longer sit behind the fails check). src/build/verdict.js:312-316 drops the PASS refusal on a failing record. src/audit/separation.js:411-413 stops closing the round on a failing test-strength record. Help text for finalise, verdict test and test-strength follows (src/cli/build.js, src/cli/test-strength.js:278-293). guidance/managed/agent-instructions-block.md: the operator register (:12-75) goes whole, RULE 13 becomes "Deliver in rounds: the twelve rules" as one numbered list 1 to 12, the five-role build loop (:342-394) keeps only the commands; regenerate the hash and the harness-template.md fence with scripts/gen-managed-artefacts.mjs. guidance/build-cycle.md: the twelve rules as one numbered list, the DEFINE exit rule 6 verbatim with "No throwaway.", the FINALISE paragraph "requires the test-strength record" and "never refuses on its result"; overview.md:34 and :46 (closer kept word for word; "the test-strength report shows it, and the reviewer judges it"); build-cycle-playbook.md:29, :126; src/build/bundle.js:287-305 runbook DEFINE (rule 6) and REVIEW ("test strength is recorded for the reviewer's adequacy verdict") lines; goldens regenerate through their generators. Keep green: AC-20401-3 (RULE 13 still names "merging before Finalise has written complete", e.g. in rule 10) and AC-20401-5 (no sentence with "Hand:" outside the 0.37.x transition, so the twelve rules carry no Hand: trailer sentence). DEFINE pass 2 (rulings 11 to 13): AC-20502-6, src/finalise/light.js judgeTestStrength checks the record before coverage: present but not a valid TestStrengthReport v1 (version 1, 40-hex head, scope acs|reviewVerdict|fbs, criteria array of rows with string acId and result pass|fail|blocked, top-level result, totals object; unparseable JSON counts as invalid, not missing) refuses "test-strength record at <H7> is not a valid TestStrengthReport v1"; embedded head not H refuses "test-strength record at <H7> is for <X7>, not the reviewed head"; no re-verification of mutant rows or totals. AC-20501-3, every packed file is scanned: guidance/discovery/discovery-viewer-command-page.md (:248, :256, :257, :276, :290), guidance/discover-prototype.md:55, guidance/discovery-prototypes.md:55, guidance/define-draft-shapes.md:14, guidance/build-cycle-playbook.md:135, comments across src/ (work-item, dispatch ids, operator and stage-keeper rulings by date or number, Dave and Dex), CHANGELOG.md, releases/releases.yaml (Dex), src/ruleset/ruleset.json provenance.designWorkItem (read by nothing); rcf/ goes with AC-20501-1. AC-20503-1 (amended test): the managed block's headings are the 0.40.1 headings with RULE 13 renamed, the preamble keeps no list or indented example, the Build loop keeps exactly its backticked rcf commands and no sentence naming two or more of the five hands.
